svg.title: 4. Data centre exit and Outposts at the plant
svg.text: 18-month plan (DC A lease ends in month 18)
Data centre exit over Direct Connect, plus an Outposts rack for the one workload that has to stay at the plant
Block-level, continuous replication on private IPs.
Test launch, then cutover per wave.
Incremental syncs nightly, final sync at cutover.
Full load + CDC. Cut over when lag < 5 s
Re-home DX location A to DC B
Bandwidth check: 8 Gbps is 1 GB/s, about 86 TB a day at full rate. At a realistic 60% that is ~50 TB a day,
so 420 TB of files is ~9 days of transfer. Planned as 3 weeks with business-hours throttling.
and monitoring live in the Region.
Local gateway to the plant LAN
MES must answer the line in under 5 ms. If the service link drops, plan for
running-but-unmanaged: size for N+1 locally, keep line data on S3 on Outposts.
